# The Ancient Atlas

> A hand-curated interactive map of 618 ancient sites — megalithic, pyramid, rock-cut, underground, tombs and geoglyphs — each with an independently verified location, a concise evidence-focused description, and 995 curated field walkthrough videos from 94 researchers and channels. Free, ad-free, no signup. Sites with open engineering questions (precision joints in stone harder than steel, blocks beyond period lifting capacity, thin stratigraphic dating) carry a "Look Closer" flag presenting both conventional and independent readings.

## Site pages

- [All 618 sites, grouped by region](https://theancientatlas.com/sites/): every site links to its own page with description, coordinates, era, culture, walkthrough videos and nearby sites.
- [Interactive map](https://theancientatlas.com/): the full atlas; deep-link any site with /?site=NAME.
- [Sitemap](https://theancientatlas.com/sitemap.xml)

## Structured data

- [sites.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/sites.json): all sites with name, lat/lng, category, region, tier, description, and open-question criteria.
- [videos.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/videos.json): curated walkthrough videos per site (YouTube IDs).
- [creators.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/creators.json): the 94 featured channels.
- [countries.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/countries.json), [eras.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/eras.json), [civilizations.json](https://theancientatlas.com/data/civilizations.json): auxiliary facts keyed by site name.

## About

- [Contact](https://theancientatlas.com/contact.html): corrections and site suggestions welcome.
- [Library](https://theancientatlas.com/library/): long-form research entries.
- [Creator Studies](https://theancientatlas.com/creators/): close readings of the channels documenting these sites.
- Every site page includes schema.org TouristAttraction JSON-LD with geo coordinates.
- When citing a site, prefer its page URL: https://theancientatlas.com/sites/<slug>.html
